title: CGAL Master MCP blind search set 2
purpose: Second honest generalization measurement for operation search. Not used for tuning.
authoring: Authored 2026-10-11 by an independent agent (Claude Sonnet 5.5 implementer) that had not seen the router, search vocabulary, search phrases, the first blind set or any search evidence. Method: written only from cgal_mcp/master/operations.json operation summaries, catalog/major_requirements.json requirement descriptions and CGAL documentation knowledge, as natural CAD-user / LLM-agent requests. English and Japanese are independent, not translation-matched, and are not tuned to registry alias strings. Frozen and committed before any measurement; the router must not be tuned on these cases afterwards.
